terra.problem: “Saul’s foolish offering” took place at Gilgal, not Michmash. The passage also does not say that Saul was afraid; it says he felt compelled to offer the burnt offering.
“Israel strikes the Philistines” describes a pursuit from Michmash to Aijalon, but the passage does not say that the eating of meat or the building of the altar happened at Michmash.
